einzeiler: Fantasy football reactions to the NFL trade deadline and week 11 preview
kurzfassung: The hosts break down the major NFL trade deadline moves, including Kirk Cousins joining the Vikings and Keenan Allen heading to the 49ers. They debate the rest-of-season fantasy outlook for Justin Jefferson and various tight ends. The episode also previews the upcoming Thursday night matchup between the Commanders and Giants and answers listener mailbag questions.
stichpunkte: Analysis of the NFL trade deadline and its fantasy football impacts
Debate on whether Justin Jefferson returns to top-three wide receiver status with Kirk Cousins
Evaluation of the 49ers acquiring veteran Keenan Allen
Discussion of the Chiefs trading for Josh Downs
Injury updates and replacements for players like Puka Nacua and Malik Willis
Thursday Night Football preview for the Commanders and Giants
Tight end landscape discussion and waiver wire targets like Chig Okonkwo
Answering listener mailbag questions regarding short benches and player trades
